item.title: New colors, new mission for Ian James at Jaguar TCS
item.description: New year, new colors. Ian James is a familiar face in the Formula E paddock, but this season he finds himself in a different environment having shed the papaya of McLaren for the black, white, and gold of Jaguar TCS Racing.James has seen it all, from championship wins with the...

item.title: Degree of challenge facing Cadillac clear from shakedown, Bottas says
item.description: “We still have lots of problems to solve and a bit of a mountain to climb, but we are getting there, step by step."

item.title: Racing on TV, January 30-February 1, 2026
item.description: NASCAR returns with the Clash at Bowman Gray, Formula E in Miami, Asian Le Mans, King of the Hammers on RACER Network.

item.title: O’Sullivan leads Miami E-Prix rookie practice
item.description: As well as giving inexperienced drivers seat time, the non-competitive 40-minute session plays a vital role as teams look to maximize their data gathering ahead of the first Formula E race at the Hard Rock Stadium venue.

item.title: Bourdais parts ways with Tower Motorsports LMP2 team
item.description: The team says the 46-year-old former IndyCar star has elected to shift his full focus towards the FIA WEC, which he will take on this season with Cadillac Hertz Team JOTA in Hypercar.

item.title: Honda looks set to launch WEC Hypercar program for 2027
item.description: After much deliberation, Honda appears to be on the cusp of confirming a Hypercar program in time for the 2027 FIA World Endurance Championship.

item.title: Hamilton feeling buoyed by Ferrari vibes after topping Barcelona times
item.description: Lewis Hamilton says he feels “the winning mentality” within Ferrari and its personnel more than ever after completing a productive week of running with its 2026 car at the Barcelona shakedown.

item.title: Ticktum tops times in first Miami E-Prix practice
item.description: Ticktum usurped DS Penske’s Taylor Barnard in the final minutes of the session to set the fastest time in the first free practice of the weekend.

item.title: IndyCar announces Freedom 250 GP of Washington, D.C. as 18th race
item.description: The IndyCar Series has expanded its 17-race calendar for 2026 to include a brand-new street race around Washington, D.C. as part of the country’s 250th birthday celebrations.

item.title: NTSB releases preliminary report on Biffle plane crash
item.description: Greg Biffle was not flying the plane that took his life and that of six others when it crashed in Statesville, North Carolina in December.
